meta.name: citation-management
meta.description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检索学术文献并生成规范参考文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果平时需要大量检索和引用学术文献
copy.tagline_en: Find papers and generate correctly formatted citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently search and cite academic literature

howto.what: 装上后,你可以让 Claude 查找学术论文(Google Scholar、PubMed),把 DOI、PMID、arXiv 编号转成规范的 BibTeX 条目;它会核对引用信息、补全缺失的卷号页码,并整理去重、排序 BibTeX 文件。
howto.when: 当你想查找论文、把 DOI/PMID 变成 BibTeX 条目、或检查引文准确性时,Claude 会使用这个技能。

say.text: 检查我的 references.bib,补全缺失的卷号、页码,并去重。
say.note: 会运行校验、补全和去重。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search academic databases (Google Scholar, PubMed), convert DOIs/PMIDs/arXiv IDs into properly formatted BibTeX, fill in missing metadata (volume, pages) via web search, and clean/deduplicate/sort BibTeX files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find papers, convert DOIs/PMIDs/arXiv IDs to BibTeX, verify citation accuracy, or clean up a BibTeX file.

say_en.text: Convert DOI 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2 to a BibTeX entry.
say_en.note: It will extract metadata and generate BibTeX.

say_en.text: Search PubMed for CRISPR papers after 2020 and show 20 abstracts.
say_en.note: It will run a PubMed search and return results.

say_en.text: Check my references.bib, fill in missing volume/pages, and deduplicate.
say_en.note: It will validate, enrich, and clean the file.
